keyLimits.en: Custom quote based on employee count, modules and contract length; official site could not be accessed (HTTP 429) to confirm exact figures.

addOns.en: Recruiting module (applicant tracking), estimated separately by third parties, not confirmed on official site.
Payroll module, integrated with time tracking and employee data.

cautions.en: No public price list; official pricing page returned HTTP 429 during research and could not be verified directly.

capabilities.en: Core HR: employee records, absence and leave management, org charts in one system.
Structured onboarding workflows with automated task assignment for new hires.
Integrated payroll processing that syncs with employee data and time tracking.
Optional applicant tracking (Personio Recruiting) add-on for end-to-end hiring.

limitations.en: No public pricing; buyers must request a custom quote before knowing the real cost.
Recruiting and payroll are separate paid modules, not included in the base HR package.

reason.en: Comparable all-in-one HRIS for SMEs with similar core HR, time-off and onboarding scope.
Modern HRIS competitor targeting the same SME segment with people analytics and onboarding.
European HRIS competitor with a similar mix of core HR, payroll and recruiting modules.
Overlaps for HR and payroll, particularly for distributed or international teams.

unknowns: Exact plan names, tiers and per-employee prices could not be verified: personio.com/pricing/ returned HTTP 429 during research.
Trial length, free plan existence and full platform/mobile app availability not confirmed from an official source.
